023public class HullRestoration {
024        
025        public static float RECOVERY_PROB = 2f;
026        public static float CR_PER_SMOD = 5;
027        
028        public static float CR_MAX_BONUS = 15;
029        public static float CR_MINUS_PER_DMOD = 5;
030        
031        public static float DMOD_AVOID_MAX = 0.9f;
032        public static float DMOD_AVOID_MIN = 0.75f;
033        
034        public static float DMOD_AVOID_MIN_DP = 5f;
035        
036        public static float DP_REDUCTION = 0.1f;
037        public static float DP_REDUCTION_MAX = 5f;
038        
039        public static float PARTS_DROP_RATE_INCREASE_MULT = 4;
040        
041        
042        /**
043         * Lowest probability to avoid d-mods at this DP value and higher.
044         */
045        public static float DMOD_AVOID_MAX_DP = 60f;
046        
047        public static class Level1 implements FleetStatsSkillEffect {
048                public void apply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id, float level) {
049                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SHIP_RECOVERY_MOD).modifyFlat(id, RECOVERY_PROB);       
050                }
051                public void unapply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id) {
052                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SHIP_RECOVERY_MOD).unmodify(id);        
053                }
054                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
055                        return "All of your ships are almost always recoverable if lost in combat";
056                }
057                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
058                        return null;
059                }
060                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
061                        return ScopeDescription.FLEET;
062                }
063        }
064        
065        public static class Level1B implements CharacterStatsSkillEffect {
066                public void apply(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, String id, float level) {
067                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.ALLOW_RESTORE_ANYWHERE).modifyFlat(id, 1);
068                }
069
070                public void unapply(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, String id) {
071                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.ALLOW_RESTORE_ANYWHERE).unmodify(id);
072                }
073                
074                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
075                        return "Repairing d-mods no longer requires being docked at a spaceport";
076                }
077                
078                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
079                        return null;
080                }
081
082                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
083                        return ScopeDescription.NONE;
084                }
085        }       
086        
087        public static class Level2 implements ShipSkillEffect {
088                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
089                        float dp = DMOD_AVOID_MIN_DP;
090                        if (stats.getFleetMember() != null) {
091                                dp = stats.getFleetMember().getDeploymentPointsCost();
092                        }
093                        float mult = 1f - (dp - DMOD_AVOID_MIN_DP) / (DMOD_AVOID_MAX_DP - DMOD_AVOID_MIN_DP);
094                        if (mult > 1f) mult = 1f;
095                        if (mult < 0f) mult = 0f;
096                        
097                        float probAvoid = DMOD_AVOID_MIN + (DMOD_AVOID_MAX - DMOD_AVOID_MIN) * mult;
098                        if (Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) {
099                                probAvoid = DMOD_AVOID_MIN;
100                        }
101                        
102                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DMOD_ACQUIRE_PROB_MOD).modifyMult(id, 1f - probAvoid);
103                }
104                
105                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
106                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DMOD_ACQUIRE_PROB_MOD).unmodify(id);
107                }
108                
109                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
110                        String lowDP = "" + (int) DMOD_AVOID_MIN_DP;
111                        String highDP = "" + (int) DMOD_AVOID_MAX_DP;
112                        String lowChance = "" + (int) Math.round(DMOD_AVOID_MIN * 100f) + "%";
113                        String highChance = "" + (int) Math.round(DMOD_AVOID_MAX * 100f) + "%";
114                        if (Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) {
115                                return "Ships lost in combat have a " + lowChance + " chance to avoid d-mods";
116                        }
117                        return "Ships lost in combat have a " + lowChance + " (if " + highDP + " deployment points or higher) to " + highChance + " (" + lowDP + " DP or lower) chance to avoid d-mods";
118                        //"Ships lost in combat have a 90% (if 5 deployment points or lower) to 75% (50 DP or higher) chance to avoid d-mods
119                        //return "+" + (int)(CR_PER_SMOD) + "% maximum combat readiness per s-mod built into the hull";
120                }
121                
122                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
123                        return null;
124                }
125                
126                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
127                        return ScopeDescription.PILOTED_SHIP;
128                }
129        }
130        public static class Level3 implements ShipSkillEffect {
131                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
132                        float num = 0f;
133                        if (stats.getVariant() != null) {
134                                num = stats.getVariant().getSMods().size();
135                        }
136                        stats.getMaxCombatReadiness().modifyFlat(id, num * CR_PER_SMOD * 0.01f, "Hull Restoration skill");
137                }
138                
139                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
140                        stats.getMaxCombatReadiness().unmodify(id);
141                }
142                
143                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
144                        return "+" + (int)(CR_PER_SMOD) + "% maximum combat readiness per s-mod built into the hull";
145                }
146                
147                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
148                        return null;
149                }
150
151                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
152                        return ScopeDescription.PILOTED_SHIP;
153                }
154        }
155        
156        public static class Level3B implements ShipSkillEffect {
157                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
158                        FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
159                        
160                        
161                        float dmods = 0;
162                        if (member != null) {
163                                dmods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
164                        } else if (stats.getVariant() != null) {
165                                dmods = DModManager.getNumDMods(stats.getVariant());
166                        }
167                        
168                        float bonus = CR_MAX_BONUS - dmods * CR_MINUS_PER_DMOD;
169                        bonus = Math.round(bonus);
170                        if (bonus < 0) bonus = 0;
171                        
172                        stats.getMaxCombatReadiness().modifyFlat(id, bonus * 0.01f, "Hull Restoration skill");
173                }
174                
175                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
176                        stats.getMaxCombatReadiness().unmodify(id);
177                }
178                
179                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
180                        return "+" + (int)(CR_MAX_BONUS) + "% maximum combat readiness for all ships, minus " + (int)CR_MINUS_PER_DMOD + "% per d-mod (minimum of 0%)";
181                }
182                
183                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
184                        return null;
185                }
186                
187                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
188                        return ScopeDescription.PILOTED_SHIP;
189                }
190        }
191        
192        public static class Level4A implements FleetStatsSkillEffect {
193                public void apply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id, float level) {
194                        stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.DOMAIN_GRADE_PARTS_DROP_RATE_MULT).modifyMult(id, PARTS_DROP_RATE_INCREASE_MULT);
195                        //stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.FUEL_USE_NOT_SHOWN_ON_MAP_MULT).unmodify(id);
196                }
197                
198                public void unapply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id) {
199                        stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.DOMAIN_GRADE_PARTS_DROP_RATE_MULT).unmodify(id);
200                }
201                
202                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
203                        if (Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) {
204                                CommoditySpecAPI parts = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.PARTS);
205                                String name = Misc.ucFirst(parts.getName().toLowerCase());
206                                return "Increases the chance to find " + name + " during post-battle salvage operations by " + (int)Math.round(PARTS_DROP_RATE_INCREASE_MULT) + Strings.X;
207                        } else {
208                                if (FieldRepairsScript.MONTHS_PER_DMOD_REMOVAL == 1) {
209                                        return "Chance to remove one d-mod per month from a randomly selected ship in your fleet; faster for low-DP ships";
210                                } else if (FieldRepairsScript.MONTHS_PER_DMOD_REMOVAL == 2) {
211                                        return "Chance to remove a d-mod from a randomly selected ship in your fleet every two months";
212                                } else {
213                                        return "Chance to remove a d-mod from a randomly selected ship in your fleet every " +
214                                                                FieldRepairsScript.MONTHS_PER_DMOD_REMOVAL + " months";
215                                }
216                        }
217                }
218                public String getEffectPerLevelDescription() {
219                        return null;
220                }
221                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
222                        return ScopeDescription.FLEET;
223                }
224        }
225        
226        public static class Level4B implements FleetStatsSkillEffect {
227                public void apply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id, float level) {
228                }
229                
230                public void unapply(MutableFleetStatsAPI stats, String id) {
231                }
232                
233                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
234                        if (Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) {
235                                return null;
236                        }
237                        return "Chance to quickly remove one d-mod from newly acquired ships; higher for ships with more d-mods";
238                }

241                }

244                }
245        }
246        
247        
248        public static class Level5 extends BaseSkillEffectDescription implements ShipSkillEffect {
249                public void createCustomDescription(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, SkillSpecAPI skill, 
250                                TooltipMakerAPI info, float width) {
251                        init(stats, skill);
252                        float opad = 10f;
253                        Color c = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
254                        //info.addPara("Affects: %s", opad + 5f, Misc.getGrayColor(), c, "fleet");
255                        info.addPara("Affects: %s", opad + 5f, Misc.getGrayColor(), c, "pristine and near-pristine ships (at most one d-mod)");
256                        info.addSpacer(opad);
257
258                        String max = "" + (int) DP_REDUCTION_MAX;
259                        String percent = "" + (int)Math.round(DP_REDUCTION * 100f) + "%";
260                        info.addPara("Deployment point cost reduced by %s or %s points, whichever is less",
261                                        0f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), Misc.getHighlightColor(), percent, max);                  
262                        
263                }
264
265                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
266                        FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
267                        float dmods = 0;
268                        if (member != null) {
269                                dmods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
270                        }
271                        
272                        if (dmods > 1) return;
273                        
274                        float baseCost = stats.getSuppliesToRecover().getBaseValue();
275                        float reduction = Math.min(DP_REDUCTION_MAX, baseCost * DP_REDUCTION);
276                        
277                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DEPLOYMENT_POINTS_MOD).modifyFlat(id, -reduction);
278                }
279
280                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
281                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(Stats.DEPLOYMENT_POINTS_MOD).unmodifyFlat(id);
282                }
283        }
284}
